privacy.title: Privacy Notice (KVKK)
privacy.description: Why and on what legal basis Borsalıyorum processes your personal data, who receives it, how long we keep it and your rights under the KVKK.

blocks.text: Under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (“KVKK”), the data controller is [[ph:company]] (“Borsalıyorum”, “we”). This notice is provided under Article 10 of the KVKK and the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles for Fulfilling the Obligation to Inform. The Turkish version prevails.

When you sign up we collect your email address and password (we never store your password in plain text). If you choose “Continue with Google”, we receive your name, email address and Google account ID from Google. We then record the username and display name you choose and your confirmation that you are 18 or older. When you sign in we log your IP address and the time, for security and legal record-keeping.

items: **Identity and contact:** email address, username, display name; if you use Google, the name on your Google account and your Google account ID.
**Account security:** password (only in irreversible form, at our authentication provider), email verification status, session information.
**Statements and records:** your confirmation that you are 18 or older; the version and time at which you accepted the Terms of Use and confirmed reading this notice.
**User content:** posts, replies, likes, follows, links and images you share.
**Security logs:** IP address (stored encrypted), port, time and type of action for sign-ins and content actions.
**Stored on your device:** your theme preference and drafts you are writing; never sent to our servers (see the [[link:cookies|Cookie Policy]]).

blocks.text: **How we collect it:** Data is collected electronically, partly by automated means, through the sign-up, sign-in and profile forms, Google sign-in, the post and reply screens and server logs. We do not ask for your date of birth, ID number or special categories of personal data. Please do not share special categories of data such as health, religion or political opinions, or other people's personal data, in your posts.

sections.heading: Your rights under Article 11 of the KVKK

blocks.text: By applying to us you can:

items: learn whether your personal data is processed,
request information about the processing,
learn the purpose of processing and whether data is used accordingly,
know the third parties in Türkiye or abroad to whom data is transferred,
request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data,
request deletion or destruction under the conditions in Article 7 of the KVKK,
request that corrections, deletions and destructions be notified to the third parties who received the data,
object to a result against you arising solely from automated analysis of your data,
claim compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing.

blocks.text: In line with the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles of Application to the Data Controller, you can send your request **from the email address registered to your Borsalıyorum account** to [[mail:support]], in writing to [[ph:address]], or by registered electronic mail (KEP) to [[ph:kep]]. Please include your full name, username, contact address and your request.

We will answer free of charge as soon as possible and within 30 days at the latest. If the action requires an additional cost, the fee set by the Personal Data Protection Board may be charged. If your request is rejected, you find the answer insufficient or we do not answer in time, you may complain to the Personal Data Protection Board within 30 days of learning of our answer and in any case within 60 days of your application.
We only use strictly necessary cookies that keep you signed in and secure; we do not use analytics or advertising cookies. See the [[link:cookies|Cookie Policy]].
When we update this notice we change its version number and effective date. We will tell you about significant changes on the platform.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: Which cookies and browser storage Borsalıyorum uses, why, and for how long.

blocks.text: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser. Local storage (localStorage) and session storage (sessionStorage) store data in your browser in a similar way. This policy covers all of them and should be read together with the [[link:privacy|Privacy Notice]].

**We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.** We only use cookies needed for the service to work and device storage that remembers the preferences you choose. Strictly necessary cookies do not require consent, so we do not show a cookie consent banner.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: The rules you agree to when using Borsalıyorum: prohibited content, content licence, sanctions and dispute resolution.

blocks.text: These Terms of Use (“Terms”) are the agreement between you and [[ph:company]] (“Borsalıyorum”) for the use of the website and apps it operates (the “Platform”). You accept the Terms with a separate box at sign-up; the version and time of your acceptance are recorded. The Turkish version prevails.

The [[link:community|Community Guidelines]] and the [[link:disclaimer|Investment Disclaimer]] form part of these Terms. How your personal data is processed is explained in the [[link:privacy|Privacy Notice]].

sections.heading: What the Platform does and does not do

items: Borsalıyorum is a social platform where users share views about stocks, indices and other investment instruments. Content is created by users; for that content Borsalıyorum is a hosting provider under Law No. 5651.

**Borsalıyorum does not provide investment advisory services or investment advice.** It does not offer buy, sell or hold recommendations, price targets, model portfolios or signal services. User content reflects its authors' personal views.
The Platform shows no price data; stock pages only show the ticker, the name and links to external sources such as the Public Disclosure Platform (KAP).
Your investment decisions and their outcomes are yours alone. See the [[link:disclaimer|Investment Disclaimer]].
You must be 18 or older to join. Accounts found to belong to someone under 18 are closed and their data deleted.
The information you give at sign-up must be accurate. Your username cannot be your email address, someone else's name or misleading; reserved names such as institution names cannot be used.
You are responsible for the security of your account and the secrecy of your password. If you think your account has been used without permission, write to [[mail:support]] immediately.
You may only open an account for yourself. Opening accounts for others, in bulk or by automated means is prohibited.
You cannot post or reply until you verify your email address.

blocks.text: You may not share or do any of the following:

items: Any unlawful content or incitement to crime.
Insults, threats, harassment, hate speech, discrimination or content that violates personality rights.
Sharing other people's personal data (e.g. phone number, address, ID details) without permission.
Content that infringes copyright, trademarks or other intellectual property rights.
Spam, repeatedly posting the same content, fake engagement or bots.
Impersonating another person, an institution or Borsalıyorum.
Obscene or violent content, or content that may harm children.
Sharing malware or phishing links; attempting to compromise the Platform's security or operation; collecting data from the Platform by automated means without permission.

sections.heading: No market manipulation, inside information or paid promotion

blocks.text: Conduct that breaches Capital Markets Law No. 6362 may be a crime. In particular, the following are prohibited:

items: **Market manipulation:** spreading false, inaccurate or misleading information, rumours, news or comments to influence prices, values or investors' decisions; taking part in or organising coordinated “pump and dump” schemes.
**Inside information:** sharing non-public information that may affect prices, or steering others based on it.

**Unauthorised investment services:** offering or advertising personalised investment advice, portfolio management, “signals” or “VIP groups” for a fee or on a regular basis; directing people to unauthorised providers (including crypto asset service providers).

**Promoting stocks or crypto for a benefit:** promoting a specific capital market instrument or crypto asset in exchange for money, gifts, discounts or any other benefit. This is not allowed even with the “Ad / Collaboration” label. Paid promotion of any kind is prohibited in replies.

blocks.text: You can report such content to us. If competent authorities (e.g. the Capital Markets Board, public prosecutors) request it, we share the relevant records in accordance with the law.

items: For every post you create in return for money, gifts, discounts or any other benefit from a brand or person, you must turn on “This post is an ad or paid collaboration” when creating it. An “Ad / Collaboration (Reklam / İşbirliği)” label appears at the top of the post.

Hiding the label or otherwise concealing the commercial relationship is covert advertising and is prohibited (Consumer Protection Law No. 6502 and the Regulation on Commercial Advertising and Unfair Commercial Practices).
Posts mentioning stocks, crypto or other investment instruments cannot be shared as ads or collaborations.
Where we consider it necessary, we may add the “Ad / Collaboration” label to a post ourselves.
You keep the rights to the content you share. You are responsible for ensuring your content is lawful and does not infringe third-party rights.

By sharing content you grant Borsalıyorum a free, non-exclusive licence to store, reproduce, display, communicate to the public and technically adapt it (e.g. resizing, previews) for the purpose of operating the Platform. This licence ends when you delete the content or your account, subject to legal retention obligations.
We may create a preview with a title, short description and small image for links you share. We remove the preview if the rights holder asks us to.
The Borsalıyorum name, logo and the Platform's software belong to Borsalıyorum and may not be used without permission.

We may review, remove or restrict access to content that breaches these Terms, the Community Guidelines or the law, upon notice or on our own initiative. We have no obligation to review content in advance.

Depending on the severity and repetition of a breach, we may: warn you, remove content, add the “Ad / Collaboration” label, temporarily restrict posting features, suspend your account or close it permanently.
For serious breaches (e.g. market manipulation or criminal content) we may act without prior warning and notify the competent authorities.
When we remove your content or restrict your account, we tell you why where possible. To appeal a decision, write to [[mail:support]].
You can also send notices of unlawful content and personality-rights complaints to the same address.
You can end your membership at any time. Send your account deletion request from your registered email address to [[mail:support]].
We may end your membership if you breach the Terms seriously or repeatedly.
When your membership ends, your data is deleted or anonymised according to the retention periods in the [[link:privacy|Privacy Notice]].
The Platform is provided as is; we do not guarantee that it will run without interruption or errors. We may suspend the service temporarily for maintenance or security.
We do not guarantee the accuracy of user content and are not liable for losses from investment decisions you make based on it.
Liability that cannot be limited by law (e.g. for intent and gross negligence) is not affected.

blocks.text: We may change the Terms. When we do, we update the version number and effective date and announce significant changes on the Platform a reasonable time before they take effect. After a significant change you may be asked to accept the new version to keep using the Platform.

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye. The courts and enforcement offices of [[ph:court]] have jurisdiction over disputes. Where you act as a consumer, your right to apply to consumer arbitration committees and consumer courts under Law No. 6502 is reserved.

disclaimer.title: Investment Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: Content on Borsalıyorum is not investment advice. The legal disclaimer in line with Capital Markets Board rules.

items: Posts and replies on Borsalıyorum are their authors' personal views. Borsalıyorum does not verify or adopt them.

Borsalıyorum is not licensed to provide investment advice; it offers no buy/sell recommendations, price targets, model portfolios or signal services. Trending lists are based on a stated criterion (e.g. “most mentioned in the last 24 hours”) and are not recommendations.
The Platform shows no price data. Follow the Public Disclosure Platform (KAP) for companies' official announcements.
If you want personalised investment advice, work with a brokerage firm, portfolio management company or authorised bank licensed by the Capital Markets Board.
Capital market instruments and crypto assets can lose value; you may lose some or all of the money you invest.

blocks.text: Spreading false or misleading information to influence prices may be a crime under Capital Markets Law No. 6362 and is prohibited by the [[link:terms|Terms of Use]]. If you see such content, report it to us.

community.title: Community Guidelines
community.description: The rules for a respectful, honest and safe discussion in the Borsalıyorum community.

blocks.text: Borsalıyorum is a community where investors exchange ideas. These guidelines keep discussion respectful, honest and safe. They form part of the [[link:terms|Terms of Use]]; breaches are subject to the sanctions there.

items: Challenge ideas, not people. No insults, humiliation, threats, harassment or hate speech.
Do not share other people's personal details (phone, address, workplace, photos) without permission.
Different investment views are legitimate; do not mock anyone for their losses.
Separate facts from opinions. When sharing a claim, cite its source (e.g. a link to the KAP disclosure).
Do not present unverified rumours as fact; even a post starting with “I heard that” can move prices.
If you hold a position in a stock you mention, we encourage you to say so.
Do not misrepresent yourself or pretend to be an expert, an institution or another user.

sections.heading: Do not try to move the market

items: No coordinated buy or sell calls such as “let's all buy” or “limit up tomorrow”.
Do not share non-public company information.
Do not promote stocks or crypto in return for money, gifts or any other benefit. This is not allowed even with the “Ad / Collaboration” label.
Do not advertise paid signals, “VIP groups”, copy trading or unauthorised investment services.

blocks.text: Turn on the “Ad / Collaboration” option for every post where you received a benefit from a brand or person. Paid promotion is not allowed in replies.

items: Do not post the same content repeatedly or add irrelevant hashtags and tickers.
Do not buy or sell followers, likes or replies; do not use bots or multiple accounts.
Do not share phishing, malware or misleading shortened links.
Do not share unlawful, obscene or violent content, or content that may harm children.
Do not share images or text you do not have the rights to.
Report any user you believe is under 18.

blocks.text: If you see content that breaks these guidelines, write to [[mail:support]]. Depending on the severity, we may issue a warning, remove content, apply a temporary restriction or close the account. You can appeal decisions at the same address.
